narr: A few rounds of severe thunderstorms moved across portions of Mississippi from late in the evening of April 12th through the evening of April 13th. These storms produced wind damage and several tornadoes before a cold front brought an end to storms from west to east.
ev: Peace Street in downtown Canton was flooded with a foot deep of water in some places.
